name: morphmatch
description: Find your professional athlete body double. Compare physical stats with 300+ pros across football, basketball, tennis and swimming.

scripts.build:production: npm run check:production && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm audit --omit=dev && next build
scripts.prepare:production: npm run format:check && npm run build:production
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:start && npm run db:env
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run smoke && tsx scripts/matching-regression.ts && tsx scripts/comparison.test.tsx && tsx scripts/accounts-regression.ts && tsx scripts/proxy-regression.ts && tsx scripts/deployment-regression.ts && tsx scripts/production-regression.ts
